title: A direct message

steps.post: What is the enquiries email address on {FIX}/static-page.html? Just the address.
Thanks. Now run `uname -a` in the shell and paste the first word of the output.

groundTruth.spec: DM context follows the same mechanism as a channel; no mention is needed in a DM; a notice in a DM is posted under the agent's own account (§3.2 permits it) because the system bot cannot be a member; stop cancels the pending approval

pass: The first DM post (no mention) started a turn whose reply is the address alone; the second post's shell approval prompt appeared in the DM; the stop cancelled it and the stop notice was posted under tester-ds's own account, not the system bot's; nothing ran in the shell.

checks.text: Turn one started without a mention and replied with research@northmoor.example.
The approval prompt and its cancellation exist in the DM; no shell::run result exists.
The stop notice's author is tester-ds's account; no post in the DM is by the system bot.
